info.title: dotnet-install
info.description: dotnet-install, a command-line tool for installing .NET SDKs and runtimes

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: NativeAOT-powered dotnet-install manager that mirrors the shell scripts

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --channel
options.description: Download channel (LTS, STS, or specific version train) [default: LTS]

options.name: --quality
options.description: Optional build quality (daily, preview, GA)

options.name: --version
options.description: The SDK or runtime version to install [default: Latest]

options.name: --internal
options.description: Download internal builds [default: False]

options.name: --jsonfile
options.description: Path to global.json that pins the SDK version

options.name: --install-dir
options.description: Installation root [default: <auto>]

options.name: --architecture
options.description: Target architecture (x64, arm64, etc.) [default: <auto>]

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Install only a runtime (dotnet, aspnetcore, windowsdesktop)

options.name: --shared-runtime
options.description: Obsolete switch that maps to --runtime dotnet [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Emit install plan without downloading [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation when the requested version is already installed [default: True]

options.name: --no-path
options.description: Skip PATH mutation for current process [default: False]

options.name: --persist-path
options.description: Persist the install location to the user PATH for new shells [default: False]

options.name: --azure-feed
options.description: Override the default Azure feed

options.name: --uncached-feed
options.description: Use an uncached feed

options.name: --feed-credential
options.description: Token appended to feed URLs

options.name: --proxy-address
options.description: Proxy to use for HTTP requests

options.name: --proxy-use-default-credentials
options.description: Use default credentials for proxy [default: False]

options.name: --proxy-bypass-list
options.description: Comma separated hosts that bypass the proxy [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --skip-non-versioned-files
options.description: Skip overwriting non-versioned files [default: False]

options.name: --keep-zip
options.description: Do not delete downloaded archives [default: False]

options.name: --zip-path
options.description: Custom path for the downloaded archive

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Emit verbose diagnostics [default: False]

options.name: --runtime-id
options.description: Legacy runtime identifier override

options.name: --os
options.description: Override OS detection (linux, alpine/linux-musl, osx, freebsd, rhel.6)

options.name: --download-timeout
options.description: HTTP download timeout in seconds [default: 1200]

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Install the requested SDK/runtime version and remove obsolete versions in the same channel

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Upgrade only the .NET runtime [default: False]

options.name: --sdk-only
options.description: Remove only obsolete SDK directories and keep related runtimes [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Emit the upgrade plan without installing or removing anything [default: False]

options.name: --install-dir
options.description: Installation root [default: <auto>]

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: One or more SDK or runtime versions to upgrade to

commands.name: self-update
commands.description: Update the dotnet-install executable from GitHub releases

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Resolve the latest release asset without downloading or replacing the executable [default: False]

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Include prerelease GitHub releases when resolving a self-update target [default: False]

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove an installed SDK or runtime

options.name: --install-dir
options.description: Installation root [default: <auto>]

options.name: --sdk-only
options.description: Remove only the SDK [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: List the version folders that would be removed without deleting them [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Emit verbose diagnostics [default: False]

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: SDK or runtime version to remove
